Wright's complete introduction to Between Light and Shadow; John Clute direct in two long Wolfe pieces (2001, 2009); Michael Andre-Driussi's 2009 IRoSF essay via Wayback; Colin Manlove's chapter opening page and note 8 via the Wayback capture of the SpringerLink record (pp. 198-216). PARTIAL, by relay with page numbers -- Clute's Strokes (1988) quoted at pp. 160, 161 and 163 in Attending Daedalus and in a review of Strokes; Wright's 'suggestive rather than definitive' recovered verbatim with its page (AD p. 188) from Aramini's dissertation; Lexicon Urthus described in an Ultan's Library news item and a bookseller's catalogue. NOT REACHED -- Manlove's chapter body (the Internet Archive copy is lending-restricted and every search-inside endpoint refused); Borski's Solar Labyrinth and The Long and the Short of It (only publisher descriptions, tables of contents, one full review and Aramini's verdict; Google Books serves no snippet text and the Books API is over quota); Logos 18.4 'Art and Allegory' (publisher record only, no abstract, $20 paywall; MUSE, Gale and thefreelibrary all Cloudflare-gated); Critical Quarterly 'Time After Time' (Crossref record only; Unpaywall reports no OA copy, Wiley and Academia.edu Cloudflare-gated); Joan Gordon's Starmont monograph re-read abandoned because both extractions of the scanned text layer are column-interleaved OCR too corrupt to quote verbatim, so the predecessor's Gordon claims stand unaltered.
